purpose.seed: Repeatable authored review layout and plant variation; never gameplay RNG.
purpose.tree_height_m: Mature tree scale and connected canopy above the walking route.
purpose.tree_triangle_target: Retain irregular bark/limb silhouettes while reducing the dense generated source.
purpose.canopy_sprays: Overlapping leaf groups anchored to actual upper branches.
purpose.leaf_length_m: Individual broadleaf size, with small natural variation.
purpose.leaf_width_fraction: Broad folded leaves instead of angular needles.
purpose.canopy_detail_distance_m: Keep lobed leaf outlines near the observer; the same distant sprays use simpler folded leaves.
purpose.canopy_detail_fade_m: Two metres of transition around the canopy detail distance; no foliage group is removed.
purpose.understory_attempts: Seeded candidate groups before excluding the walking path and water; this seed retains 834 groups in the isolated composition.
purpose.terrain_size_m: Local composition extent including distant framing; not world generation.
purpose.terrain_step_m: Support and contour sampling for the authored review floor.
purpose.route_z_m: Beginning and end of the short woodland review walk.
purpose.eye_height_m: First-person review camera above the actual support mesh.
purpose.walk_speed_m_s: Slow observation pace in this art review, not player tuning.
purpose.scar: Shared four-second Red ambient crest; narrow core within a wider dark physical incision. Never a work/ready or attack cue.
purpose.lighting: Three repeatable review exposures. Sun and ambient are light energies, fog is density; bloom stays off.
